_comment: Single source of truth for per-route head tags. Read by scripts/prerender.mjs (Node, readFileSync) and imported by the page components (Vite JSON import), so the head a crawler receives and the head react-helmet-async renders can never drift apart. Every route MUST appear here; prerender.mjs fails the build if one is missing.
